Title: Su-34 Fullback
Description: Su-34 Fullback - twin-seat, twin-engine strike fighter for VTOL VR. Custom exterior model and a side-by-side two-crew cockpit on a proven two-seat airframe. Two players can fly it when the mission-editor player spawn is set to 2 slots; the package is built on the EF-24G or T-55 donor, so that DLC is required. Full loadout and mission-editor support. Exterior 3D model: "Su-34" by bohmerang (https://sketchfab.com/bohmerang), a free model used with the author's permission - thank you! This is a free, non-commercial fan project with no donations.
